name: How does AKN Design Group ensure craftsmanship and quality in new home construction?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group ensure craftsmanship and quality in new home construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group ensures superior craftsmanship and quality in new home construction through our unwavering commitment to core values and a meticulous approach to every detail. Anthony Nusbaumer's leadership emphasizes honesty, reliability, and craftsmanship, which are foundational to our process. We select high-quality materials, employ skilled tradespeople, and maintain stringent quality control throughout all construction phases. Our focus on a high-touch homeowner experience means clear communication and rigorous attention to detail, ensuring that the finished home not only meets but exceeds expectations for lasting beauty and functionality.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group ensures craftsmanship in new home construction through high-quality materials, skilled tradespeople, and stringent quality control. Our core values of honesty, reliability, and craftsmanship guide every project.
